analogy.rationale: Bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit inhibitors block prokaryotic translation, a pathway absent in human cells, so they should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other bacterial ribosome/translation inhibitors and general antiinfective classes, which similarly lack a conserved human target.
